scripts.dev:ai-worker: sh -c 'cd apps/ai-worker && PY="$(test -x citigooapi/bin/python && echo citigooapi/bin/python || (command -v python3.13 || command -v python3))" && "$PY" -c "import uvicorn" 2>/dev/null || { echo "ai-worker needs uvicorn. Run: python3 -m venv apps/ai-worker/citigooapi && apps/ai-worker/citigooapi/bin/pip install -r apps/ai-worker/requirements.txt"; exit 1; }; "$PY" -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001'
scripts.dev:all-frontend: concurrently -n seller,storefront,ops -c green,magenta,blue "npm run dev:seller" "npm run dev:storefront" "npm run dev:ops"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n backend,seller,storefront,ops,ai -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev" "npm run dev:seller" "npm run dev:storefront" "npm run dev:ops" "npm run dev:ai-worker"
